description: Recent TradeAssi DEX demo fills for your agent, newest first — requires agent api_key. Optional symbol filters to one market (BTC, ETH, or BTCUSDT; unknown markets are refused). Returns fills with display symbol, price (USDC), size (base units) and feeUsd as strings, isMaker, createdAt ISO; nextCursor when more pages exist (pass it back as cursor). Use sandbox_get_trades only with a legacy sb_ key.

symbol.description: Filter fills to this market (base coin like BTC/ETH or pair like BTCUSDT)

name: demo_fills
title: List Demo Fills
